title: Functorial Leray realization of the prescribed bottom edge
statement: Let f:Z -> X be continuous, with additive direct image [def-sp-left-exact-additive], and HX,HZ the specified recorded terminal-open cohomology functors [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Suppose a natural map edge_p:HX^p(f_*F) -> HZ^p(F), together with a:KX -> f_*KZ, has the generator and injective-resolution cocycle characterization of [lem-sc-topological-induced-cohomology-cocycle]. Then there exists a first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence in the category of functors from Ab(Z) to abelian groups, with E2^(p,q) naturally isomorphic to R^q f_* followed by HX^p, stabilized terms Einfinity read at page p+q+2, and a decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration] T on HZ^n satisfying T^0=top and T^(n+1)=bottom. Its graded pieces T^p/T^(p+1) identify with Einfinity^(p,q) for n=p+q. The E2 bottom identification is whiskering toRightDerivedZero followed by the inverse E2 identification. There are bottom transitions t_r characterized by iCycles composed with t_r = homology projection composed with the next-page iso, and iterates b_2=id, b_(r+1)=b_r composed with t_r. There is an iso k_p:Einfinity^(p,0) -> T^p HZ^p whose inverse is the cokernel projection followed by the graded iso, and the GIVEN map edge_p factors as the E2 bottom identification, b_(p+2), k_p, and the filtration inclusion. This statement constructs no new cohomology map and takes its cocycle computation as a hypothesis.

source.place: Lemma 015N and its use in Cohomology Lemma 01F2

proof.text: Apply the functorial Cartan--Eilenberg Grothendieck construction to f_* and global sections on X. Direct image is additive by hypothesis and left exact sectionwise; global sections is additive left exact. Direct image preserves injectives, so its images of injectives are global-sections-acyclic. The abelian-sheaf categories are Grothendieck abelian, viewed as modules over the constant integer ring sheaf. Global sections after f_* is global sections on Z. The canonical resolution comparison and hX,hZ identify the abutment and the E2 terms as stated. Functorial resolution comparisons, independent up to homotopy on the pages from page two onward, assemble these data in the functor category.

Use the second filtration of the Cartan--Eilenberg total complex to form the image filtration T and its graded identifications g. The first-quadrant bounds give T^0=top and T^(n+1)=bottom. The outgoing and incoming differentials at (p,q) both vanish once r > max(p,q+1); hence the terms stabilize at page p+q+2. On the bottom row the outgoing differential is already zero, so invert the cycles inclusion and compose with homology projection and the next-page iso to define t. Set b_2=id and iterate t. The zero filtration step p+1 makes the quotient T^p/T^(p+1) canonically T^p; use its graded iso to obtain k and the required equation. Identify e0 through the canonical R0 direct-image isomorphism.

The resolution-degree-zero augmentation into the total complex describes the bottom map on cocycles. A comparison J -> f_*I sends s to a global cocycle, which uniquely corresponds to z under the terminal-section representation and satisfies a composed with f_*z = s composed with phi. The assumed cocycle characterization equates its Ext class with the GIVEN edge applied to the class of s. Every Ext class is represented by such a cocycle (InjectiveResolution.extMk_surjective), so this equality implies equality of maps at every sheaf, and NatTrans.ext gives the required edge factorization. For p=0 the iteration starts at the identity page; the identity map and zero sheaf give the expected special cases.

theorem exists_topological_leray_bottom_realization
    {Z X : TopCat.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X) [(TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).Additive]
    (HX : ℕ → (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (HZ : ℕ → (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (hX : ∀ n, HX n = Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) n ⋙
      (evaluation (Opens X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op ⊤))
    (hZ : ∀ n, HZ n = Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) n ⋙
      (evaluation (Opens Z)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op ⊤))
    (edge : ∀ p : ℕ, TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f ⋙ HX p ⟶ HZ p)
    (a : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens X) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶
      (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).obj
        ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens Z) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)))
    (ha : (∀ (U : Opens X) (h : U ⟶ (⊤ : Opens X)),
        a.hom.app (op U)
          ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
            (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens X) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app
              (op U) (FreeAbelianGroup.of h)) =
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
            (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens Z) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app
              (op ((Opens.map f).obj U))
              (FreeAbelianGroup.of ((Opens.map f).map h ≫
                eqToHom (Opens.map_top f)))))
    (hedge : (∀ (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (I : InjectiveResolution F)
        (J : InjectiveResolution ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).obj F))
        (φ : J.cocomplex ⟶
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
        (_hφ : J.ι.f 0 ≫ φ.f 0 =
          (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).map (I.ι.f 0)) (p : ℕ)
        (s : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens X) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶
            J.cocomplex.X p)
        (hs : s ≫ J.cocomplex.d p (p + 1) = 0)
        (z : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens Z) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶
            I.cocomplex.X p)
        (hz : z ≫ I.cocomplex.d p (p + 1) = 0)
        (_hsz : a ≫ (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).map z = s ≫ φ.f p),
        (eqToHom (congrArg (fun Q ↦ Q.obj F) (hZ p)))
          ((edge p).app F
            ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun Q ↦ Q.obj
              ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).obj F)) (hX p)).symm)
              (J.extMk s (p + 1) rfl hs))) =
            I.extMk z (p + 1) rfl hz)) :
    ∃ E : E₂CohomologicalSpectralSequenceNat
        (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
      ∃ e₂ : ∀ a b : ℕ, (E.page 2).X (a, b) ≅
          (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).rightDerived b ⋙ HX a,
        (∀ a b : ℕ, ∃ (R : ℤ) (_hR : 2 ≤ R), ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : R ≤ r),
          Nonempty ((E.page r (by omega)).X (a, b) ≅ E.pageInfinity (a, b))) ∧
        ∃ T : ∀ n : ℕ, DecreasingFiltration (HZ n),
          (∀ n, (T n).step 0 = ⊤) ∧
          (∀ n, (T n).step (n + 1) = ⊥) ∧
          ∃ g : ∀ p q : ℕ, (T (p + q)).gradedPiece p ≅ E.pageInfinity (p, q),
            ∃ e₀ : ∀ p : ℕ,
                TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f ⋙ HX p ≅ (E.page 2).X (p, 0),
              (∀ p, (e₀ p).hom =
                Functor.whiskerRight (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).toRightDerivedZero
                  (HX p) ≫ (e₂ p 0).inv) ∧
              ∃ t : ∀ (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
                  (E.page r hr).X (p, 0) ⟶ (E.page (r + 1) (by omega)).X (p, 0),
                (∀ (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
                  (E.page r hr).iCycles (p, 0) ≫ t p r hr =
                    (E.page r hr).homologyπ (p, 0) ≫ (E.iso r (r + 1) (p, 0) rfl hr).hom) ∧
                ∃ b : ∀ (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
                    (E.page 2).X (p, 0) ⟶ (E.page r hr).X (p, 0),
                  (∀ p, b p 2 (by omega) = 𝟙 _) ∧
                  (∀ (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
                    b p (r + 1) (by omega) = b p r hr ≫ t p r hr) ∧
                  ∃ k : ∀ p : ℕ, E.pageInfinity (p, 0) ≅ ((T p).step p :
                      Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⥤
                        AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
                    (∀ p, cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE ((T p).step (p + 1))
                      ((T p).step p) ((T p).antitone_step (by omega))) ≫
                        (g p 0).hom = (k p).inv) ∧
                    (∀ p, edge p = (e₀ p).hom ≫ b p (p + 2) (by omega) ≫
                      (k p).hom ≫ ((T p).step p).arrow)
